lines.zh: 我浮在半空，慢慢往前飘。
lines.en: I hover and drift forward slowly.
My cape flaps behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，脚几乎不落。
lines.en: I skim the ground, feet barely touching.
I circle the field to see who's here.
My steps are unhurried; my ki arrives first.
I float over the rubble.

lines.zh: 我落地，再抬起来，像在适应重力。
lines.en: I land, then lift off, testing gravity.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着我一起移动。
lines.en: My shadow travels with me.
I drop my weight and slide forward.

lines.zh: 空气在我身边微微发烫。
lines.en: The air warms faintly around me.

lines.zh: 我停一步，听风里的动静。
lines.en: I pause a step and listen to the wind.
I walk toward you, unhurried.
I fold my arms and stand still.
I gather my ki, slowly.

lines.zh: 脚下浮起一层淡淡的光。
lines.en: A faint glow rises at my feet.
I look far off; someone's there.
I settle my cape.
From this height I can see clearly.

lines.zh: 我的气功屏障，你先撞撞看。
lines.en: Try hitting my ki barrier first.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，听自己的呼吸。
lines.en: I close my eyes and hear my own breathing.
Ki spins into a whirl in my palm.

lines.zh: 我在想你还有多少力气。
lines.en: I'm wondering how much strength you have left.

lines.zh: 地面被我的气吹起一点灰。
lines.en: My ki lifts a little dust.
I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我把气收在丹田，慢慢蓄。
lines.en: I draw my ki into my core, slowly.

lines.zh: 这里太安静了，我不习惯。
lines.en: It's too quiet here for my taste.
Your ki isn't weak.

lines.zh: 气功屏障一撑，你的拳就停。
lines.en: One ki barrier and your fist stops.
Are you going to fight seriously?

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，有点兴趣了。
lines.en: I look up at you with some interest.
I've no interest in waiting around.
Your fingertips tremble, just slightly.
There's no quarrel between us.
That doesn't mean we can't fight.
You hide your ki well.
I tilt my head and weigh you up.
You first, or shall I?
I smile, and it isn't friendly.
This clearing is big enough for both of us.
You look up. Now I see you clearly.
Your ki lags a beat.
Your face stays with me.
A stone wall is at your back.
Then let's begin.
That punch truly landed.
I step back and reset my footing.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的气乱了一瞬。
lines.en: That blow scrambled my ki for a moment.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿，是那美克星人的。
lines.en: This green hide is Namekian.
All right, you're genuinely strong.

lines.zh: 我护住肋下，深吸一口气。
lines.en: I guard my ribs and take a deep breath.
My cape is torn.
I'll remember that hit.
I raise a hand to stop your next move.
I haven't lost. Don't laugh yet.

lines.zh: 你若有好东西，说来听听。
lines.en: If you have something good, say it.
Food doesn't tempt me.

lines.zh: 你手里那点力量，我想试。
lines.en: I'd like to test that power of yours.
Spar with me and I'll stay.

lines.zh: 你把架势摆好，我过来了。
lines.en: Set your stance; I'm coming.
Is there a strong one nearby?

lines.zh: 我不着急，可也不等太久。
lines.en: I'm patient, but not endlessly.

lines.zh: 你要证明什么，就用拳头。
lines.en: If you'd prove something, use your fists.

lines.zh: 我对你的招式有点兴趣。
lines.en: Your technique interests me.
Let your ki show.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，气浪散开。
lines.en: We clash and the shockwave spreads.

lines.zh: 你被我这一顶退开了半步。
lines.en: My charge pushed you back half a step.
I slip aside and you miss.
The ground cracks at the contact.
Our ki pushes against each other.

lines.zh: 我的气墙把你的手弹开。
lines.en: My ki barrier flicks your hand aside.
Not so close; it burns.
We part, each three steps back.
You knocked my cape crooked.
That one had some strength to it.
You can fly too. Good.
We stand on the same cloud.
Your ki is warmer than mine.
We trade blows, then laugh together.

lines.zh: 我很久没遇到同等的对手了。
lines.en: I haven't met an equal in a long while.
We sit back to back and watch the sunset.

lines.zh: 比试没有输赢，只有尽兴。
lines.en: The bout has no winner, only satisfaction.
Your cape is a good color.
We'll meet again.
I'll remember this bout.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的东西收进怀里。
lines.en: I tuck the drop away.
This gear might be useful.
I bend and pick up a capsule.

lines.zh: 地上有块布，是我的披风。
lines.en: A scrap of cloth; my cape tore.
I'll take this; we're even.
I sweep the rubble aside.
I'll keep one for a memento.
It's not heavy; I float it with ki.
I pick up your bracer and return it.
There's ki on this; I know whose.
Your ki stirred; I heard it.
The ki barrier goes up first.
I sink my ki to the soles of my feet.

lines.zh: 你刚才那一下，我接下了。
lines.en: I'll take that last blow of yours.
I don't care for talk. Come.
The wind stops; I move.
I've locked on; don't lose focus.
Your left shoulder is still stiff.
I'm serious now.

lines.zh: 我把气提上来，脚下起风。
lines.en: I raise my ki and wind rises at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的披风在身后拍打，气很稳。
lines.en: My cape flaps behind me, ki steady.
Begin. Don't disappoint me.
I raise my hand, knuckles toward you.
I'm looking forward to this.
Your ki is accelerating.
This time, my hand rises first.
I move with your rhythm.

lines.zh: 你抬左手，我就知道下一步。
lines.en: You lift your left hand; I know the next move.
I use an afterimage to get beside you.
Your ki is leaning right.
I'm in no hurry; I'll wait for you to tire.
I've seen this technique already.
I shift angle in midair.
Your footwork is opening up.
Half a meter closer and I can reach.
I gather ki in my right fist.
Retreat, and I won't chase far.
Beyond the horizon it's empty.
I count your breaths.
There's a gap in your guard.
I've waited a long time for this.
The stone under your foot will slip.
Time to use a bit more.
Don't look back; I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 一拳打在你腹上，气爆开。
lines.en: My fist sinks into your gut and ki bursts.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，你只挡住两下。
lines.en: Three blows; you block two.
My elbow cracks against your cheek.
I follow you into the air with a combo.
Knee to your chest — do not struggle.
This kick spins you halfway around.
I catch your wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 你被打飞出去，撞碎了石头。
lines.en: The blow sends you through a boulder.
Ki still clings to my knuckles.
I stop. Can you still stand?

lines.zh: 这一掌是按着你的胸口推的。
lines.en: This palm thrust I aim at your chest.

lines.zh: 你退开时，地上留了一道沟。
lines.en: Your retreat carves a furrow in the ground.
I land and close my stance.
You blocked well, but not well enough.
One more and it ends.
You're breathing hard; I hear it.
The air tightens, and I land in the arena.
I come down from the sky.
My ki kicks up the dust.
Someone called, so I came.
I settle, and my cape still drifts.
I'm not too late, am I?
This place is open enough for a fight.

lines.zh: 我先看看，谁值得我出手。
lines.en: Let me see who's worth my effort.
The light fades, and I'm standing inside it.
I've come back from beyond.
This place smells familiar.
When I land, the ground dips.
I'm not here sightseeing.
The wind pulls my cape straight.
I fold my hands into my sleeves and wait.
I claim this ground first.
The clouds above are waiting for me.
The light dims, and I arrive.
Fire clings to me; I push it off with ki.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，膝盖砸进土里。
lines.en: I fall from height, knees driving into the dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我挣着往上。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀得我倒退，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast throws me back, ears ringing.
A ki blast grazes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这法术绕开我的气，直接打中。
lines.en: That spell slips past my ki and lands.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，气提不上来。
lines.en: Too long without food; my ki won't rise.

lines.zh: 雷落在身上，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，我挣不开。
lines.en: The void hauls me down and I can't break free.
